# SimTower native Windows port — source preview v0.1.0

This is the first public source snapshot of the disassembly-backed x86-64
Windows port.

Highlights:

- native Win32 host with no emulator dependency;
- recovered construction, simulation, people, rendering, audio, UI, save, and
  transport systems;
- revision-0x24 `.TDT` read/write interoperability;
- 911 recovered game-owned routine mappings; and
- 14 headless native test suites.

This release intentionally has no uploaded executable or original-game asset
archive. GitHub's automatically generated source archives are the only release
downloads. Original-game and third-party attribution is in `CREDITS.md`; the
distribution boundary is documented in `DISTRIBUTION.md`.
